title: Mutually
summary: MU'TUALLY, adverb Reciprocally, in the manner of giving and receiving. The tongue and the pen mutually assist one another. [Note-Mutual and mutually properly refer to two persons or their intercourse;

inlines.v: MU'TUALLY, adverb Reciprocally, in the manner of giving and receiving. The tongue and the pen mutually assist one another. [Note-Mutual and mutually properly refer to two persons or their intercourse; but they may be and often are applied to numbers acting together or in concert.]
